elements.text: **SoundCloud — how the web app opens and plays a track**

Captured from a live browser session (anonymous, geo `KZ`) on `soundcloud.com/tien-pham-418156952/she-neva-know-lofi-ver` — track `1068221248`, 2026-08-03. Observed traffic and page state, not documentation.

Three backends: **api-v2.soundcloud.com** (internal REST, `client_id` auth) · **graph.soundcloud.com/graphql** (share + commerce) · **signed CDNs** (`*.sndcdn.com`, `playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud`) for waveform, artwork and audio. Audio is never served by the API — the API only mints a short-lived CloudFront-signed URL that the player streams.
**1 · Playback flow**

**1. Browser opens the permalink**
GET soundcloud.com/{user}/{track}

**2. SSR HTML carries the track**
window.__sc_hydration → no API call needed

**3. Track model in the client store**
media.transcodings[] + track_authorization

**4. Authorize the stream** ← the key endpoint
GET api-v2/media/{urn}/{uuid}/stream/hls
?client_id=…&track_authorization=…

**5. Response is one field**
{ "url": "…playlist.m3u8?expires&Policy&Signature" }

**6. CloudFront, signed**
GET playlist.m3u8 — VOD, EXT-X-VERSION 7

**7. Segments**
init.mp4 → data000.m4s … each ~10 s, each signed
__sc_hydration
elements.infoText:
## window.__sc_hydration

An array of `{hydratable, data}` records embedded in the HTML. Records present on a track page:

- `anonymousId` — string
- `features` — feature list
- `geoip` — `country_code`, `country_name`, `region`, `city`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `timezone`
- `privacySettings` — consent / opt-in flags
- `statsigClientInitializeResponse` — `configString`, `user` (experiments and flags)
- `trackingBrowserTabId` — string
- `apiClient` — `{ id, isExpiring }` — **this is the `client_id`**
- `user` — the artist (full user model)
- `sound` — **the track (full 47-field model)**

Reading `sound` is how the app gets the track without any API round-trip. `apiClient.id` is the `client_id` appended to every subsequent api-v2 call — observed value `sUn5toeW5d8MC2jOLpE2yAibTG7RRYsA`, together with `app_version=1785401912` and `app_locale=en`.

The `isExpiring` flag means the `client_id` rotates: read it from the page rather than hardcoding it.

elements.text: track model
elements.infoText:
## The `track` model (hydratable `sound`) — 47 fields

```json
{
  "id": 1068221248,
  "urn": "soundcloud:tracks:1068221248",
  "kind": "track",
  "title": "She Neva Know Lofi Ver",
  "duration": 165218,
  "full_duration": 165198,
  "streamable": true,
  "policy": "ALLOW",
  "monetization_model": "NOT_APPLICABLE",
  "waveform_url": "https://wave.sndcdn.com/2AIL7484hLd9_m.json",
  "permalink_url": "https://soundcloud.com/tien-pham-418156952/she-neva-know-lofi-ver",
  "track_authorization": "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...",
  "media": { "transcodings": [ /* 5 entries */ ] },
  "user": { "id": 779476813, "urn": "soundcloud:users:779476813", "username": "Tien Pham", "kind": "user" },
  "publisher_metadata": { "id": 1068221248, "urn": "soundcloud:tracks:1068221248", "contains_music": true }
}
```

### Field groups

Identity / content: `id`, `urn`, `kind`, `title`, `permalink`, `permalink_url`, `uri`, `description`, `caption`, `genre`, `tag_list`, `label_name`, `license`, `artwork_url`, `waveform_url`, `visuals`, `release_date`, `display_date`, `created_at`, `last_modified`.

Duration: `duration` (ms of the playable asset) and `full_duration` (ms of the original upload). They differ per transcoding — 165218 for the AAC presets vs 165198 for the legacy MP3.

Counters: `playback_count`, `likes_count`, `reposts_count`, `comment_count`, `download_count`.

Access / rights: `streamable`, `downloadable`, `has_downloads_left`, `public`, `sharing`, `embeddable_by`, `commentable`, `secret_token`, `state`, `policy`, `monetization_model`, `purchase_title`, `purchase_url`.

Relations: `user_id`, nested `user`, `publisher_metadata`, `station_urn`, `station_permalink`, `scheduled_timezone`, `scheduled_public_date`.

Playback: `media.transcodings[]`, `track_authorization`.

### Nested `user` (34 fields)

`id`, `urn`, `kind`, `username`, `permalink`, `permalink_url`, `uri`, `url`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `full_name`, `avatar_url`, `description`, `city`, `country_code`, `verified`, `badges`, `visuals`, `followers_count`, `followings_count`, `likes_count`, `playlist_likes_count`, `playlist_count`, `track_count`, `comments_count`, `groups_count`, `reposts_count`, `creator_subscription(s)`, `station_urn`, `station_permalink`, `date_of_birth`, `created_at`, `last_modified`.

### Waveform

`GET https://wave.sndcdn.com/{token}_m.json` (no auth):

```json
{ "width": 1800, "height": 140, "samples": [ /* 1800 ints, 0..140 */ ] }
```

elements.text: stream auth call
elements.infoText:
## The playback endpoint

```
GET https://api-v2.soundcloud.com/media/{track_urn}/{transcoding_uuid}/stream/{protocol}
      ?client_id={client_id}
      &track_authorization={jwt}
```

`{protocol}` is `hls` or `progressive`. You never build this URL yourself — take it verbatim from `track.media.transcodings[].url` and append the two query params.

### Real request

```
GET https://api-v2.soundcloud.com/media/soundcloud:tracks:1068221248/79fd32ca-f1fb-415b-b95d-42c1f22115b2/stream/hls
      ?client_id=sUn5toeW5d8MC2jOLpE2yAibTG7RRYsA
      &track_authorization=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...
```

### Response — a single field

```json
{
  "url": "https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/2AIL7484hLd9/aac_160k/79fd32ca-f1fb-415b-b95d-42c1f22115b2/playlist.m3u8?expires=1785762213&Policy=eyJTdGF0ZW1lbnQi...&Signature=A-5A4ELu1SItmdw...&Key-Pair-Id=K34606QXLEIRF3"
}
```

For the `progressive` transcoding the same call returns a plain signed MP3 instead:

```json
{ "url": "https://cf-media.sndcdn.com/2AIL7484hLd9.128.mp3?Policy=...&Signature=...&Key-Pair-Id=APKAI6TU7MMXM5DG6EPQ" }
```

### Observed player behaviour

On play the app resolved several transcodings and then streamed `aac_160k`. It probed `abr_sq` (404 in this anonymous session), `aac_96k`, the legacy `mp3_0_1` HLS and the `progressive` variant. So a client must treat individual presets as fallible and fall back — do not assume the "best" preset is available.

No separate play-count or play-event request was seen for an anonymous listener. SoundCloud's analytics traffic goes to `dwt.soundcloud.com/js/` and third-party ingestors, not to a public `plays` endpoint.

elements.text: m3u8 + segments
elements.infoText:
## The HLS playlist and segments

Head of the real `playlist.m3u8` (signature params truncated):

```
#EXTM3U
#EXT-X-VERSION:7
#EXT-X-TARGETDURATION:10
#EXT-X-MEDIA-SEQUENCE:0
#EXT-X-PLAYLIST-TYPE:VOD
#EXT-X-MAP:URI="https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/2AIL7484hLd9/aac_160k/79fd32ca-.../init.mp4?expires=1785762250&Policy=...&Signature=...&Key-Pair-Id=K34606QXLEIRF3"
#EXTINF:10.007800,
https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/2AIL7484hLd9/aac_160k/79fd32ca-.../data000.m4s?expires=...&Policy=...&Signature=...
#EXTINF:10.007800,
.../data001.m4s?...
#EXTINF:9.984580,
.../data002.m4s?...
```

Fragmented MP4: one `init.mp4` then `dataNNN.m4s` segments of ~10 s. Every segment URL carries its own CloudFront signature.

### Expiry observed

The playlist URL expired roughly 7 minutes after issue; segment URLs roughly 8 minutes. A track longer than that requires re-fetching the playlist mid-playback — so re-request the signed URL rather than caching it.

elements.text: **2 · Endpoints**

**Track metadata — `api-v2.soundcloud.com`**

```
GET /resolve?url={permalink_url}&client_id={cid}
    permalink → entity. Same 47-field track object as hydration,
    including media.transcodings AND track_authorization. Works anonymously.

GET /tracks/{id}?client_id={cid}                 track by numeric id, includes media
GET /tracks?ids={id,id,...}&client_id={cid}      batch, returns an array

GET /tracks/{id}/related        ?anon_user_id&limit=10&offset=0&linked_partitioning=1
GET /tracks/{id}/comments       ?sort=newest&threaded=1&limit=20
GET /tracks/{id}/comments       ?threaded=0&limit=200   (waveform-anchored pass)
GET /tracks/{id}/likers         ?limit=9
GET /tracks/{id}/reposters      ?limit=9
GET /tracks/{id}/albums                    ?representation=mini&limit=10
GET /tracks/{id}/playlists_without_albums  ?representation=mini&limit=10

GET /users/{id}                             artist model
GET /users/{urn}/web-profiles               social links
GET /playlists/{id}?representation=full     sidebar playlists

GET https://wave.sndcdn.com/{token}_m.json  waveform, no auth
```

Every api-v2 call carries `client_id`; app-issued calls also append `app_version` and `app_locale`. The `client_id` is public (it ships in the HTML) but it rotates and is rate-limited.

**The playback endpoint** — see step 4 on the left:

```
GET /media/{track_urn}/{transcoding_uuid}/stream/{hls|progressive}
      ?client_id={cid}&track_authorization={jwt}
→ { "url": "<CloudFront-signed URL>" }
```
**3 · GraphQL**
**4 · Transcodings**

One entry of `track.media.transcodings[]`:

```json
{
  "url": "https://api-v2.soundcloud.com/media/soundcloud:tracks:1068221248/79fd32ca-f1fb-415b-b95d-42c1f22115b2/stream/hls",
  "preset": "aac_160k",
  "duration": 165218,
  "snipped": false,
  "format": { "protocol": "hls", "mime_type": "audio/mp4; codecs=\"mp4a.40.2\"" },
  "quality": "sq",
  "is_legacy_transcoding": false
}
```

The five transcodings offered for this track, and what the authorization call returned for an anonymous listener:

```
preset      protocol     quality  legacy  auth  CDN host
aac_160k    hls          sq       no      200   playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud
aac_96k     hls          lq       no      200   playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud
abr_sq      hls          sq       no      404   —
mp3_0_1     hls          sq       yes     200   cf-hls-media.sndcdn.com
mp3_0_1     progressive  sq       yes     200   cf-media.sndcdn.com
```

`snipped: true` marks a preview-only asset (paywalled or monetized). Together with `policy`, `monetization_model` and `streamable`, restrictions are expressed **in the model** rather than by omitting the transcoding — so check those fields before assuming full playback.

`abr_sq` 404s here: adaptive bitrate is not served to this anonymous session even though the transcoding is advertised.
**5 · Authorization — three layers, no login**

**`client_id`** — public app identifier shipped in the HTML at `__sc_hydration.apiClient.id`. Required on every api-v2 and GraphQL call. Carries an `isExpiring` flag, so treat it as rotatable.

**`track_authorization`** — an HS256 JWT minted per track, per session, delivered alongside the track model. Decoded payload:

```json
{
  "geo": "KZ",
  "sub": "",
  "rid": "1ae24ccc-fd25-4b38-84a8-098ca6c1df22",
  "iat": 1785754782
}
```

`geo` pins the token to the requester's country (this is where geo-restriction is enforced), `sub` is the user URN (empty when anonymous), `rid` a request/session id, `iat` the issue time. Without it `/media/.../stream/...` is rejected, and it is bound to the session that produced the track model — a token harvested elsewhere will not work.

**CloudFront signed URLs** — the audio itself: `expires`, `Policy` (base64 JSON with a `DateLessThan` / `AWS:EpochTime` condition), `Signature`, `Key-Pair-Id`. Minted per playlist and per segment, valid for minutes only.
**6 · Full request sequence when a track page opens**

**1. Document** — `GET soundcloud.com/{user}/{track}` returns HTML with `window.__sc_hydration`. The track is already there; there is no fetch for it.

**2. Session bootstrap, in parallel** — `GET api-auth.soundcloud.com/oauth/session` · `GET soundcloud.com/versions.json` · `GET api-v2/announcements` · `POST api-v2/smartnudges/banner/0` · `GET api-v2/payments/quotations/consumer-subscription` · `GET api-v2/payments/quotations/creator-subscription` · repeated `POST api-v2/me` (anonymous session pings).

**3. Page enrichment, all keyed by the id already known from hydration** — `tracks/{id}/comments` (twice: threaded list, then a 200-item pass for waveform comments) · `tracks/{id}/related` · `tracks/{id}/albums` · `tracks/{id}/playlists_without_albums` · `tracks/{id}/likers` · `tracks/{id}/reposters` · `users/{urn}/web-profiles` · `playlists/{id}?representation=full` for each sidebar playlist.

**4. GraphQL** — `ResolvePermalink` and `TrackBuyModule`.

**5. Waveform** — `GET wave.sndcdn.com/{token}_m.json`.

**6. On play** — pick a transcoding → authorize → stream (steps 4–7 on the left).

**Soft navigation:** clicking a track from a list produced **no** `resolve` or `tracks/{id}` call. Collection endpoints such as `tracks/{id}/related` and search results already return complete track objects — `media` and `track_authorization` included — so the entity is served from the client-side store. `GET /resolve?url=` is the permalink→entity lookup for the case where only a URL is known (deep links, embeds).
**7 · If you reimplement this**

Read the track from `__sc_hydration` when you have the HTML, or from `/resolve?url=` when you only have a permalink — both return `media.transcodings` and `track_authorization` together, and both work anonymously.

Prefer `aac_160k` HLS for quality, `progressive` MP3 for the simplest implementation. Exchange the transcoding URL for a signed CDN URL; that exchange is the only step that fails on authorization grounds.

Re-request signed URLs instead of caching them — the CloudFront policy expires in minutes. Check `policy`, `monetization_model`, `streamable` and `snipped` before assuming full playback, and expect individual presets to 404 while others succeed.

This is undocumented internal API surface. SoundCloud changes it without notice and their terms restrict non-browser use of it; the supported alternatives are the public Developer API / oEmbed and the widget iframe player.
